snippet.title: Deep Dish Dungeon Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A new gameplay trailer offered hilarious vignettes from Deep Dish Dungeon, Behold Studios' handcrafted solo & co-operative spelunking game, where you craft, cook and face off against snakes and skeletons. It's coming to PC in Fall 2026, but there's a demo available now on Steam.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871520/Deep_Dish_Dungeon/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
